summary: Packs fields of the source struct (this) into a contiguous output buffer using MemcpyWithAdvancePointer, which advances the destination pointer slot (&a2) as it copies. Copies 4 bytes from this+4, 32 bytes from this+8, five single bytes from this+40..44, then a variable-length copy from this+45 whose byte count is read from the byte field at this+44. Writes the total number of bytes consumed to *a3 and returns the last copy call's result. Structural twin of StructFieldSerialization (0057a270) per cluster-copy prelabel.

local_names.this: source struct base whose fields are packed starting at this+4
local_names.a2: destination buffer pointer (slot advanced by each copy call; initial value saved in v3)
local_names.v3: saved initial destination pointer used to compute total bytes written
local_names.a3: output pointer receiving the total bytes written

operations.description: v3 = a2 — save the initial destination pointer
MemcpyWithAdvancePointer(&a2, (void*)(this + 4), 4) — copy 4 bytes from this+4 into the output buffer
MemcpyWithAdvancePointer(&a2, (void*)(this + 8), 0x20) — copy 32 bytes from this+8 into the output buffer
five successive MemcpyWithAdvancePointer calls of 1 byte each from this+40, this+41, this+42, this+43, this+44
result = MemcpyWithAdvancePointer(&a2, (void*)(this + 45), *(unsigned __int8*)(this + 44)) — variable-length copy whose byte count is the byte field at this+44
*a3 = a2 - v3 — store the total number of bytes written
return result — propagate the last MemcpyWithAdvancePointer return value
